name: security-audit-kit
description: Judgment layer for a pinned, local security scan: triage scanner findings real-vs-false-positive with an evidence bar, semantic SAST (authz/IDOR/logic), AI/LLM security review, STRIDE threat modeling, and a one-command audit. The skills drive the repo's own vendored, pinned scanner (tools/security-audit-kit/scan.sh); the plugin never downloads one.

interface.longDescription: Skills that judge what a pinned, local security scan found: triage each finding as real or a false positive against an evidence bar (sink, untrusted source, unbroken path), semantic SAST for authorization, IDOR and business logic, an AI/LLM security review mapped to the OWASP LLM Top 10, a STRIDE threat model, and a one-command audit. The skills drive the repository's own vendored scanner (tools/security-audit-kit/scan.sh, installed with bootstrap.sh); the plugin downloads nothing.
capabilities: Triage scanner findings as real or false positive, with the evidence each verdict rests on
Semantic SAST: horizontal and vertical authorization, IDOR, business-logic flaws
AI/LLM security review mapped to the OWASP LLM Top 10
One-command audit that runs only the deep passes the repository calls for
defaultPrompt: Triage the findings of the last security scan
Run a security audit of this repository
